weather.note: Counts are distinct event representatives within each entry category/checkpoint; rows reuse events. Older checkpoint-only archives save 50–100-cent quotes, so their lower-price coverage is incomplete. No opposite-side bid is converted into a sale bid. Missing quotes are excluded, not interpreted as safe holding.

method: Observed settlement-loss rates by series, original entry category, current bid and remaining time. One event representative per category; Wilson 95% intervals. Descriptive, not an optimized or validated exit policy. Complete future paths are not required. The 2-cent sale cost is a stress assumption, not verified fees.
